description:
Among the first perfume creations of the house of Givenchy stands the legendary scent of L'Interdit from 1957, dedicated to actress Audrey Hepburn as the most significant muse of this fashion designer.

In 2018, its new, modern version called L'Interdit Givenchy comes out, developed by perfumers Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo and Fanny Bal as a floral-woody composition. The perfume is built on the basis of contrast between a bouquet of white flowers (including jasmine, tuberose and orange blossom) and intense woody and earthy notes of patchouli and vetiver. The concept behind the creation is the "thrill of the forbidden" and the challenge of crossing the line.

ACTIVE INGREDIENTS:

"A white floral exalted with a dark accord. The first resolutely underground flower.
The white notes - orange blossom, jasmin and tuberose - are interlaced with darker more mysterious notes of vetiver and patchouli.
A generous intense brightness that isn’t afraid of subversion.
Unforgettable, intense, addictive and fearlessly elegant. The shocking side of chic."

The bottle of thick glass pays homage to the original shape with a more modern outline with the 4 G logo added to the black ribbon that encircles the neck. The face of the new L'Interdit release is actress Rooney Mara. Givenchy L'Interdit is available in 35, 50 and 80 ml Eau de Parfum.
descriptionFa:
در میان اولین عطرهای تولید شده توسط خانه مد Givenchy، عطر افسانه‌ای L'Interdit از سال 1957 قرار دارد که به بازیگر مشهور آدری هِپبورن، مهم‌ترین الهام‌بخش این طراح مد، تقدیم شده است.

در سال 2018، نسخه جدید و مدرن آن با نام L'Interdit Givenchy عرضه شد که توسط عطرسازان دومینیک روپیون، آن فلیپو و فانی بال به عنوان یک ترکیب گل‌دار-چوبی ساخته شده بود. این عطر بر اساس تضاد بین یک دسته گل سفید ساخته شده است.

name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Intense
description:
Intense is an edition introduced in 2007 in woody composition, designed by Jacques Cavallier. Top notes bring sweet and fresh waves of tangerine, bergamot, yuzu and orange. Heart notes create rhythm of blue lotus, camphor, cardamom, cinnamon and saffron, together with nutmeg, while base notes finish the composition with accords of incense, amber, benzoin, papyrus and grey amber. It available as 75 and 125 ml edt.

Two editions in new flacons but with the same compositions were introduced in 2009 - L\'Eau d\'Issey Pour Homme and L\'Eau d\'Issey Pour Homme Intense. Colours of the flacons - light grey and dark grey colour of asphalt make an impression of a union of water and concrete.
descriptionFa:
Intense نسخه‌ای است که در سال 2007 با ترکیبی چوبی و به طراحی ژاک کاوالیه عرضه شد. نت‌های اولیه موج‌هایی شیرین و تازه از نارنگی، ترنج، یوزو و پرتقال را به ارمغان می‌آورند. نت‌های میانی ریتمی از نیلوفر آبی، کافور، هل، دارچین و زعفران را به همراه جوز هندی ایجاد می‌کنند، در حالی که نت‌های پایه ترکیب را با رایحه‌های بخور، عنبر، بنزوئین، پاپیروس و عنبر خاکستری تکمیل می‌کنند. این عطر به صورت ادوتویلت در اندازه‌های 75 و 125 میلی‌لیتر عرضه می‌شود.

name: African Leather
description:
Inspired by the African continent, this fragrance unveils warm spicy notes of cardamom and saffron over a floral touch of geranium, which mingle with a leather accord to give life to an exceptional wild leather.

South Africa is where geranium first grew in the wild, and its presence in African Leather is a nod to its origins. Sustainably cultivated in Egypt, this particular geranium has a floral, aromatic and green character that encounters hand-picked Guatemalan cardamom, a spice with green, fruity, almost-candied accents that was used as incense in Ancient Egyptian times.

name: Meant To Be Seen
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance
description:
A scent that anchors the light when you feel unseen.

There are moments when the world looks through you—when your presence is softened, your voice hushed, your radiance dimmed by self-doubt or silence.
Meant to Be Seen is born from those moments. Not to mask them, but to transform them.

It is a fragrance that acts as an anchor of light—a quiet yet powerful reminder that your essence deserves to be felt, noticed, remembered.

Opening with the delicate brightness of bergamot and the tender grace of violet, the scent begins with a breath of clarity. At its heart, the rich creaminess of iris butter intertwines with moxalone and a soft animalic trace of civettone, creating a sensation of vulnerability refined into strength—delicate, yet unwavering.

The base grounds this luminescence with unexpected warmth. Sesame and sandalwood brings a nutty, textured depth, while ambrettolide and akigalawood wrap the composition in a radiant, skin-like finish—soft, sensual, and lingering.

Meant to Be Seen is not just a perfume—it is a declaration. For the quiet ones. For the daydreamers. For those whose glow has been dimmed but never lost. This is the scent that finds you in your stillness and reminds you:

You were never meant to hide. You were always meant to be seen.

Forbidden Temptation by Vivamor is a rich, warm fragrance built around a blend of fruit, booze, spices, and woods. The composition opens with a pairing of plum and French cognac, giving the scent a dark, fruity and liqueur-like impression. At its heart, Brazilian tonka bean, cinnamon, and tobacco add sweetness, spice, and a smoky nuance, while the base of Haitian vetiver, amber, and Madagascan vanilla provides an earthy, resinous and creamy foundation.

"The Vivamor Parfums team is thrilled to announce the launch of Forbidden Temptation, Extrait de Parfum, our latest collaboration with fragrance expert, Darian from the Bowtie Fragrance Guy."

description:
Parfums de Marly launches Althaïr, a masculine fragrance that pays homage to French haute parfumerie and the woody-vanilla-amber fragrance family.

This modern tribute features high-quality Bourbon vanilla blended with citrus, spices, and noble woods for a balance of warmth and freshness. Created collaboratively by Julien Sprecher and perfumers Hamid Merati-Kashani and Ilias Ermenidis, Althaïr boasts a captivating contrast between traditional and disruptive notes, delivering distinct opulence.

Top Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute, Bergamot From Italy, Cinnamon From Ceylon, Cardamom From Guatemala Heart: Bourbon Vanilla From Madagascar, Elemi From The Philippines
Base: Ambrox, Guaiac Wood Praline, Musk

Encased in an opaque, warm-toned brown bottle, the fragrance's imagery invites a multisensory experience.
descriptionFa:
Parfums de Marly عطر Althaïr را عرضه می‌کند، عطری مردانه که ادای احترامی است به عطر‌سازی درجه یک فرانسه و خانواده عطرهای چوبی-وانیلی-کهربایی.

این ادای احترام مدرن شامل وانیل بوربون با کیفیت بالا است که با مرکبات، ادویه‌جات و چوب‌های اصیل ترکیب شده تا تعادلی بین گرما و طراوت ایجاد کند. Althaïr که حاصل همکاری جولین اسپِرِچِر و عطرسازان حمید مراتی کاشانی و ایلیاس اِرمِنیدیس است، تضادی جذاب بین سنت

name: Eternity for Men Suede Essence
gender: men. This is a new fragrance
description:
Eternity for Men Suede Essence by Calvin Klein is a concentrated men's fragrance centred on a leather-fougère suede accord.

The fragrance opens with an invigorating burst of bergamot, delivering sparkling citrus brightness, while clary sage introduces aromatic, herbaceous nuances with a subtle green, slightly earthy character. The combination feels clean, sophisticated, and effortlessly fresh.

At its core, classic fougère materials take centre stage. Lavender lends aromatic elegance and soothing freshness, while geranium adds a crisp, minty-rosy facet that sharpens the composition and gives it a refined, masculine structure. Together, they create a polished floral-aromatic heart that is timeless yet contemporary.

The drydown is smooth, sensual, and enveloping. Velvety suede introduces a supple leather softness without smokiness, while bourbon vanilla brings creamy warmth and subtle sweetness. Tonka bean enriches the base with almond-like, lightly spiced facets that blend seamlessly with the vanilla, creating a refined ambered trail that feels elegant rather than gourmand.

این عطر با انفجاری نشاط‌آور از رایحه ترنج آغاز می‌شود که درخشندگی مرکبات را به ارمغان می‌آورد، در حالی که مریم‌گلی معطر، ظرافت‌های معطر و گیاهی با ویژگی سبز ملایم و کمی خاکی را وارد می‌کند. این ترکیب حسی تمیز، شیک و به‌طور طبیعی تازه ایجاد می‌کند.

name: XJ 1861 Naxos
description:
At perfume exhibition in Milan - Esxence 2015, Xerjoff presented for the first time his collection of three perfumes dedicated to 150th anniversary of unification of Italy and is inspired by wealth, beauty and heritage that this country possesses. The collection of XJ 1861 encompasses three fragrances XJ 1861 Renaissance, XJ 1861 Zefiro and XJ 1861 Naxos each of which provides a part of beautiful Italy: Renaissance celebrates this period in Italy, Naxos Sicily, while Zefiro celebrates eternal Rome!

XJ 1861 Naxos celebrates Sicily and its beauty, and accentuates its Mediterranean character with the composition. Citruses in top notes pose contrast to precious spices suggesting wealth of a unified country, its conquests and dominance. Composition of Naxos opens with classic, airy and fruity citrus notes of bergamot and lemon surrounded with gentle and calming lavender shades. The heart blends sambac jasmine with cinnamon, cashmeran and honey, whose romantic trail is enriched with masculine accords of tobacco and tonka from the base. Vanilla creates a soft and sensual veil by touching flowers, fruit and tobacco leaves.
descriptionFa: در نمایشگاه عطر میلان - Esxence 2015، Xerjoff برای اولین بار مجموعه سه عطری خود را که به مناسبت 150مین سالگرد اتحاد ایتالیا طراحی شده و از ثروت، زیبایی و میراث این کشور الهام گرفته است، عرضه کرد. مجموعه XJ 1861 شامل سه عطر XJ 1861 Renaissance، XJ 1861 Zefiro و XJ 1861 Naxos است که هر کدام بخشی از ایتالیای زیبا را به تصویر می‌کشند: Renaissance این دوره را در ایتالیا گرامی می‌دارد

name: Le Male Elixir
description:
Welcome on board!
The new sailor Le Male Elixir will induce burning cravings and drive your senses crazy. Burning desire spreads with the irresistible notes of fresh lavender, warming tonka bean, and gentle benzoin. With a gilded torso, this fiery novelty from Jean Paul Gaultier embodies radiant power and seductive charisma.
It is finished! You melt away with burning desire.

This intense fragrance ignites the fire of the senses on his upper body and gives the soft skin a burning sensuality. After a refreshing breeze of mint, the tide rises to addiction, becoming a glowing elixir. In this breath of fresh air, dashing lavender quickly takes on lusty proportions, enhanced by the balsamic richness of benzoin with syrupy vanilla accents. The tonka bean trumps with its warm and sweet tones between honey and tobacco. The time has come: You jump!

Radiant at first sight, glowing with masculinity, more fiery than ever. The torso is bursting with muscles, the skin is bathed in copper color by the sinking sun. What a Gaultier body... what accomplished style. Finely chiseled grooves stand out on its muscles dipped in gold and merge with the amber stripes of the sailor shirt, which plays with transparency effects in a highly sexy way.

Available as 75ml and 125ml Parfum.
descriptionFa:
به جمع ما خوش آمدید!
ملوان جدید Le Male Elixir باعث ایجاد هوس‌های سوزان می‌شود و حواس شما را دیوانه می‌کند. میل سوزان با رایحه‌های مقاومت‌ناپذیر اسطوخودوس تازه، دانه‌های گرم تونکا و بنزوئین ملایم منتشر می‌شود. این عطر جدید و آتشین از Jean Paul Gaultier با تندیسی که تنه آن طلاکاری شده است، مظهر قدرت درخشان و جذابیت فریبنده است.
تمام شد! با هوس سوزان آب می‌شوید.

این عطر شدید، آتش حواس را شعله‌ور می‌کند

description:
"Introducing a new olfactive family, Kilian Hennessy pays tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac-making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn.

A first-time collaboration with French perfumer Benoit Lapouza, the perfume Angel's Share is Kilian Hennessy's most personal fragrance creation yet, inspired by his eighth-generation inheritance of Hennessy savoir-faire in cognac making. The perfume goes deep into the cellars of founder's mind and memory, and into its most mysterious dimension: "la part des anges" or "angels' share"— an evaporation of liquor in oak barrels that lifts, while aging, like a silent offering to the gods.

Much like a Master Perfumer who crafts accords and essences in a perfume, a Master Blender combines the eaux-de-vie in perfect proportions for an exceptional cognac. Angels' Share contains the essence of Cognac derived from the liquor to lend it a natural caramel color. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and Tonka bean absolute, the scent's long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience."

Notes: Cognac, Tonka Bean and Oak wood.
descriptionFa:
«کیلیان هِنِسی با معرفی یک خانواده‌ی بویایی جدید، به میراث خود به‌عنوان وارث خانواده‌ی مشهور فرانسوی تولیدکننده کنیاک و به مواد مست‌کننده‌ی بویایی انتخابی خود برای هدایت شب به سوی سپیده‌دم ادای احترام می‌کند.

عطر Angel's Share که حاصل اولین همکاری کیلیان هِنِسی با عطرساز فرانسوی بنُوا لاپوزا است، شخصی‌ترین عطر ساخته‌شده توسط کیلیان هِنِسی تا به امروز است که از میراث نسل هشتمی او یعنی تخصص هِنِسی در تولید کنیاک الهام گرفته شده است.

name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
description:
Bleu de Chanel is a sophisticated and contemporary fragrance from Chanel that hit the market in 2010. Chanel introduces its enhanced version, Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum, in summer of 2014. The fragrance is dedicated to freedom—endless, deep and boundless.

The woody-aromatic composition created by Jacques Polge follows the original path but goes down into a sensual and oriental amber territory. Wood maintains the freshness of the original in this variant, enriched with depth and velvet amber woods.

The fragrance is available as 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.
nameFa: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum
descriptionFa:
Bleu de Chanel یک عطر پیچیده و مدرن از برند Chanel است که در سال 2010 وارد بازار شد. شانل نسخه بهبودیافته آن، Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum، را در تابستان 2014 عرضه کرد. این عطر به آزادی تقدیم شده است - آزادی بی‌انتها، عمیق و بی‌کران.

ترکیب چوبی-معطر خلق‌شده توسط ژاک پولژ از مسیر اصلی پیروی می‌کند، اما به قلمرو کهربایی حسی و شرقی وارد می‌شود. چوب طراوت اولیه را حفظ می‌کند.

description:
Bask in the entrancing warmth of a perfect aromatic vibrato. A classy, sparkling fragrance that leads with sweet floral top notes of Magnolia and Jasmine with an uplifting, citrusy touch of Bergamot and Grapefruit. A burst of Ginger and Powdery notes balanced with a dewy and fresh herbal accent to add a smooth and mellow aroma. The charming and warm base made of a semi-spicy and woody mix of Cedarwood, Oriental, Musk, Patchouli, and Orris notes creates a complex and vivid scent that is also quite subtle.

Top Notes: Jasmine, Bergamot, Grapefruit Magnolia
Heart Notes: Herbal, Ginger, Powdery
Base Notes: Cedarwood, Oriental, Musk, Patchouli, Orris
descriptionFa: در گرمای مسحورکننده یک ویبراتوی معطر بی‌نقص غرق شوید. یک رایحه شیک و درخشان که با نت‌های بالای گل‌دار شیرین مگنولیا و یاس آغاز می‌شود و با رایحه نشاط‌بخش و مرکباتی برگاموت و گریپ‌فروت همراه است. ترکیبی از رایحه‌های زنجبیل و پودری که با رایحه‌ای شبنمی و گیاهی تازه متعادل شده است تا عطر ملایم و دلنشینی ایجاد کند. رایحه پایه جذاب و گرم که از ترکیبی نیمه‌تند و چوبی از نت‌های چوب سدر، شرقی، مشک، نعناع هندی و زنبق تشکیل شده است.

description:
Aventus celebrates strength, vision and success, inspired by the dramatic life of war, peace and romance lived by Emperor Napoleon. The bottle is emblazoned with a silver emblem of a horse and rider.

The finest ingredients were hand-selected for this composition, and father and son developed this provocative, masculine and optimistic fragrance as a joint effort.

Top notes: blackcurrant, bergamot, apple and pineapple. Heart: rose, dry birch, Moroccan jasmine and patchouli. Base: oak moss, musk, ambergris, and vanilla.

Aventus is available in flacons of 30, 75, 120 and 250 ml.
descriptionFa:
Aventus قدرت، بینش و موفقیت را گرامی می‌دارد و از زندگی پرفراز و نشیب امپراتور ناپلئون در جنگ، صلح و عشق الهام گرفته است. روی بطری، نشان نقره‌ای اسب و سوارکار نقش بسته است.

برای این ترکیب، بهترین مواد اولیه به صورت دستی انتخاب شدند و پدر و پسر با تلاش مشترک این عطر تحریک‌کننده، مردانه و امیدبخش را خلق کردند.

نت‌های اولیه: انگور فرنگی سیاه، ترنج، سیب و آناناس. نت‌های میانی: گل رز، ج
